# SupplyLogix

> > SupplyLogix is a supply chain management platform currently undergoing system maintenance and CMS upgrades.

This staging environment for SupplyLogix demonstrates the platform's infrastructure built on Sitefinity CMS. The site is currently in an upgrade state, transitioning to newer versions of the content management system.

- SupplyLogix
- Sitefinity CMS
- Supply Chain Management

- CMS Upgrade

- Content Management
- System Status
- Infrastructure Updates
